description: This file defines the WebhookService class responsible for managing webhook operations such as sending, scheduling, processing, and canceling webhooks within a system. It includes methods for direct webhook delivery, scheduling time-based webhooks, and handling webhook subscriptions.

classes.name: WebhookService
classes.description: A class that manages webhook operations including sending, scheduling, processing, and canceling webhooks, with support for direct delivery and scheduled execution.

methods.name: sendWebhook
methods.description: Decides whether to schedule or directly send a webhook based on environment variable.

methods.name: scheduleWebhook
methods.description: Schedules a webhook to be sent later via tasker.

methods.name: sendWebhookDirectly
methods.description: Sends a webhook immediately via HTTP POST request.

methods.name: isJsonTemplate
methods.description: Checks if a payload template is valid JSON.

methods.name: getSubscribers
methods.description: Retrieves webhook subscribers based on options.

methods.name: processWebhooks
methods.description: Processes multiple webhooks for a trigger, with logging and error handling.

methods.name: scheduleTimeBasedWebhook
methods.description: Schedules a webhook to be sent at a specific time.

methods.name: cancelScheduledWebhooks
methods.description: Cancels scheduled webhooks for a booking and triggers.

methods.name: scheduleDelayedWebhooks
methods.description: Schedules multiple delayed webhooks for subscribers.
